```{r}
# Filter to only D vs R races
district_votes <- votes_clean %>%
  group_by(district) %>%
  summarize(
    dem_votes = sum(dem_votes, na.rm = TRUE),
    rep_votes = sum(rep_votes, na.rm = TRUE),
    has_both = (dem_votes > 0 & rep_votes > 0)
  ) %>%
  filter(has_both)  # Only include districts with both D and R candidates

```

### 2024 Election Results and the 2024 District Map

```{r}
# Democratic vote share by district
district_shares <- votes_clean |>
  group_by(district) |>
  summarize(
    dem_votes = sum(dem_votes, na.rm = TRUE),
    rep_votes = sum(rep_votes, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_votes = dem_votes + rep_votes,
    dem_share = dem_votes / total_votes
  )

# Mean-Median Score
mean_share <- mean(district_shares$dem_share)
median_share <- median(district_shares$dem_share)
mm_score <- median_share - mean_share

cat("Mean Democratic Share:", round(mean_share, 4), "\n")
cat("Median Democratic Share:", round(median_share, 4), "\n")
cat("Mean-Median Score:", round(mm_score, 4), "\n")

# Efficiency Gap (2024)
calc_wasted  <- function(party_votes, oppponet_votes) {
    total <- party_votes + opponent_votes
    threshold <- (total / 2) + 1
    
    ifelse(party_votes > opponent_votes,
        party_votes - threshold,
        party_votes)
}

# Wasted Votes
district_shares <- district_shares |>
    mutate(
        dem_wasted = calc_wasted(dem_votes, rep_votes),
        rep_wasted = calc_wasted(rep_votes, dem_votes)
    )

total_votes_all <- sum(district_shares$total_votes)
total_dem_wasted <- sum(district_shares$dem_wasted)
total_rep_wasted <- sum(district_shares$rep_wasted)

eg_2024 <- (total_dem_wasted - total_rep_wasted) / total_votes_all

cat("Total Democratic Wasted Votes:", total_dem_wasted, "\n")
cat("Total Republican Wasted Votes:", total_rep_wasted, "\n")
cat("Efficiency Gap:", round(eg_2024, 4), "\n")
cat("Efficiency Gap (%):", round(eg_2024 * 100, 2), "%\n")


```

### 2024 Election Results and the proposed 2025 District Map

```{r}
# Calculations with 2025 Districts
precinct_mapping <- read_csv("data/precinct_to_2025_district.csv")

votes_2025_districts <- votes_clean %>%
  left_join(precinct_mapping, by = "precinct_id")

district_shares_s2025 <- votes_2025_districts |>
  group_by(district_2025) |>
  summarize(
    dem_votes = sum(dem_votes, na.rm = TRUE),
    rep_votes = sum(rep_votes, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_votes = dem_votes + rep_votes,
    dem_share = calc_wasted(rep_votes, dem_votes
    )
  )

# Mean-Median Score (2025)
mm_score_2025 <- median(district_shares_2025$dem_share) - 
                 mean(district_shares_2025$dem_share)

# Efficiency Gap (2025)
district_shares_2025 <- district_shares_2025 %>%
  mutate(
    dem_wasted = calc_wasted(dem_votes, rep_votes),
    rep_wasted = calc_wasted(rep_votes, dem_votes)
  )

eg_2025 <- (sum(district_shares_2025$dem_wasted) - 
            sum(district_shares_2025$rep_wasted)) / 
           sum(district_shares_2025$total_votes)

# Compare
cat("2024 Efficiency Gap:", round(eg_2024 * 100, 2), "%\n")
cat("2025 Efficiency Gap:", round(eg_2025 * 100, 2), "%\n")
cat("Change:", round((eg_2025 - eg_2024) * 100, 2), "%\n")

if (abs(eg_2025) > abs(eg_2024)) {
  cat("\nConclusion: The 2025 map INCREASES partisan advantage")
} else {
  cat("\nConclusion: The 2025 map DECREASES partisan advantage")
}

```
